name: aztframework
description: A production-oriented TypeScript toolkit for building modular SaaS applications, APIs, automation systems and AI-powered products.
author: Thomas Azarian

scripts.build: npm run build -w @azt/core && npm run build -w @azt/logger && npm run build -w @azt/config && npm run build -w @azt/validation && npm run build -w @azt/events && npm run build -w @azt/http && npm run build -w @azt/testing
scripts.build:examples: npm run build -w rest-api-example && npm run build -w event-driven-worker-example
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @azt/core && npm run typecheck -w @azt/logger && npm run typecheck -w @azt/config && npm run typecheck -w @azt/validation && npm run typecheck -w @azt/events && npm run typecheck -w @azt/http && npm run typecheck -w @azt/testing && npm run typecheck -w rest-api-example && npm run typecheck -w event-driven-worker-example
